purpose: Golden vectors for the run-journal completeness evaluator, taken from two REAL deliveries rather than hand-authored, because the reopen and re-gate shapes they carry are the ones that falsified the evaluator. Each entry is one journal reduced to the ten kinds the evaluator reads — run.started, ticket.read, posture.declared, lens.selected, review.round.opened, review.round.closed, command.completed, gate.reported, pr.opened, run.ended — with repo.commonDir normalized to /repo/.git and every other member and the original seq left byte-identical; the reduction is verdict-preserving and was checked to be, by evaluating the full journal and the reduced one and comparing. `recordTreeSha` is the tree the delivery's `pr.opened` names, and `reviewedTreeShas` are the other raw trees its closed rounds bound — the set `verify` reads out of the record's retained review-neutral projection. DRIFT REPAIR: regenerate from the journals named in `source`; never hand-edit an `expect`.

journals.note: Seven rebase replays, every one reopened under a NEW roundId naming the round it continues in reopensRoundId (seq 80, 92, 101, 110). Its governing gate completion (seq 150) is the second of two admitting gates. This is the form the wave adopted as the workaround, and the form this evaluator now documents and pins.

payload.rationale: The repository policy activates exactly the two mandated lenses. This change promotes a reserved spine event kind into its observation-only partition and adds an optional coordination port whose whole purpose is to accept remote claims without letting any of them advance local state. The outcome lens owns whether the non-advancement and the one-blocker-per-epoch rule are actually right; the testing lens owns whether the refusals are falsifiable rather than passing vacuously, which matters unusually much here because most of the acceptance criteria are absence claims and absence assertions pass for free when the mechanism is missing. No further category is activated: no credential or secret crosses this unit, and no transport is implemented.

journals.note: Both shapes the evaluator got wrong. Seq 84 reopens round-6 under its OWN roundId (reopensRoundId === roundId), which the position-based pairing mis-paired; seq 103 then reopens it properly as round-6-replay, and that new-id pair governs, so the same-id reopen at 84 is retained history rather than the governing round. Seq 95 gate ok and 98 record ok are the completions this delivery stood on; the later seq 107 gate policy and seq 110 record policy are refusals that must not govern.

payload.rationale: the repository-mandated pair only: this delivery is documentation plus one new prose-pinning sensor over docs/managed-delivery.md, so correctness of the restated gate claim and the falsifiability of the new pin are the whole risk surface; no additional lens would reach a surface those two do not.
